text: I hired Marlow to look after a lighthouse recently. He's a pro. Went for two weeks to a very rugged one. And I loved it. He was super attentive, keeps impeccable records, super well written. The preparation for storm was very detailed. He kept the light shining beautifully through the fog. Super attentive to the wick, the lens, the weather forecast, everything. And then he makes amazing coffee, he tells great stories. Makes it very nice and homely. But being there, it is isolated, it can be quite lonely. And he is quite strict about quiet hours. Also the stairs to the top are steep. But if you are looking for atmosphere, for safety, for old school craftsmanship, then Marlow is very recommendable, I would book him again. Very dependable guy, five stars.
